# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.

[ Learn more ][90]

manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}

and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}

mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data

facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our

model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

At National Vascular Associates, we’re redefining vascular care with advanced diagnostics, proactive
prevention, and effective, minimally invasive treatments. With expert medical staff and
state-of-the-art technology, we offer care that goes beyond treatment — helping you achieve lasting
health and pain relief.

health system.

  ## The Dream Team Behind the Microplastics Mystery
  
  Could microplastics leave a DNA signature that helps explain the rise of colorectal cancer in
  younger adults? NYU Langone scientists and clinicians widen the lens on one of cancer medicine's
  most urgent questions.
  
  Play Video play_arrow
* close
  
  ## NYU Langone Performs World’s 1st HIV-to-HIV Lung Transplant
  
  The surgery brings new hope for HIV-positive patients in need of lung transplants, as it opens a
  pool of potential donors who were previously ineligible.
  
  [ Read More ][168]
  Play Video play_arrow
* ## How to Prevent Skin Cancer
  
  In the latest episode of “Future You,” NYU Langone dermatologist Jennifer Stein, MD, PhD,
  discusses melanoma risk factors, the best sun protection, and more.

## Our Mission

At NYU Langone Health, we’re redefining healthcare through our trifold mission: To care. To teach.
To discover. Our world-class services, top-tier medical education, and cutting-edge research are
what make us the nation’s top integrated academic health system.
* [John Golfinos, MD, J. Thomas Roland Jr., MD, and a resident perform surgery in an operating room
  at Tisch Hospital.]

  and a male student at the Anatomy Lab at NYU Grossman School of Medicine.]

For quality care in the US
For four years in a row, Vizient Inc. has ranked us as the nation’s top academic medical center.

## Most #1

Ranked specialties by *U.S. News & World Report*
In 2025, we ranked No. 1 in the US for neurology and neurosurgery; cardiology, heart, and vascular
surgery; pulmonology and lung surgery; and geriatrics.

**Optima Super Speciality Hospital** is a multispeciality Hospital located in Mahalakshmi layout
established in the year 2016 to provide patients with quality care at affordable prices, The clinic
is located in a prime location behind Mahalakshmi metro station. We offer NABL accredited laboratory
services, radiology services for immediate diagnosis, pharmacy and medicine delivery.

At Optima Super Speciality Hospital, we are devoted towards ethical care and medical excellence. We
strive to provide high standards of patient care with the help of highly skilled medical consultants
and caring nurses.

### Our Speciality Services

Diagnosis and Treatment of the following patient conditions
* Rheumatoid arthritis
* Spondyloarthritis
* Systematic lupus erythematosus(Lupus) / SLE
* Sjogren’s syndrome
* Osteoarthritis
* Fibromyalgia
* Vasculitis
* Paediatric rheumatology/ childhood arthritis
* Dry eye evaluation by schirmer’s test

**Optima Super Speciality Hospital** is a multispeciality Hospital located in Mahalakshmi layout
established in the year 2016 to provide patients with quality care at affordable prices, The clinic
is located in a prime location behind Mahalakshmi metro station. We offer NABL accredited laboratory
services, radiology services for immediate diagnosis, pharmacy and medicine delivery.

At Optima Super Speciality Hospital, we are devoted towards ethical care and medical excellence. We
strive to provide high standards of patient care with the help of highly skilled medical consultants
and caring nurses.

### Our Speciality Services

Diagnosis and Treatment of the following patient conditions
* Rheumatoid arthritis
* Spondyloarthritis
* Systematic lupus erythematosus(Lupus) / SLE
* Sjogren’s syndrome
* Osteoarthritis
* Fibromyalgia
* Vasculitis
* Paediatric rheumatology/ childhood arthritis
* Dry eye evaluation by schirmer’s test

### Departments

Diagnosis and Treatment of the following patient conditions

### Rheumatology

## Pharmaceutical Market Data Is Fragmented

Pharmaceutical pricing, registrations, shortages, and supplier data are spread across national
databases, regulatory agencies, and market reports. For procurement teams and pharmaceutical
traders, gathering this information can take hours or days.

Fragmented landscape slows decision-making and limits visibility into international opportunities.

### TEAMS MUST OFTEN
* Search multiple regulatory databases
* Compare pricing between markets
* Identify licensed suppliers
* Monitor product shortages
* Track product registrations and competition

## Meet A Single Platform for Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence

PharmaFootpath aggregates pharmaceutical market data from official sources and organizes it in a
searchable cloud platform. Users can explore pharmaceutical markets in seconds, not hours.

[pill icon]

### Drug Price Comparison

Compare drug prices by country and spot new market opportunities.

[suppliers icon]

### Supplier Discovery

Find licensed distributors and wholesalers globally.

[shortage icon]

### Shortage Monitoring

Monitor medicine shortages and supply disruptions worldwide.

[arrows icon]

### Regulatory Intelligence

Access product registrations and parallel trade licenses.

## See how PharmaFootpath works in your market

Schedule a Demo

## Get Market Clarity in Seconds

### Product Explorer

Review the registration information for multiple countries in a single unified database. Filter
information by MA holders, countries, presentations, strengths, pack sizes, and other
characteristics.

### Price Comparison

Prices are converted to the currency of your choice, with daily updated currency exchange rates.
This lets you compare prices globally in a single screen, immediately.

Order information by prices, or by the largest changes in prices over the last 30 days.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a pharmaceutical market intelligence platform that aggregates drug prices,
supplier information, product registrations, shortages, clinical trials, and licensing data into one
searchable system for pharmaceutical traders, wholesalers, and procurement teams.

Who uses PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is used by pharmaceutical procurement teams, parallel traders, wholesalers, and
clinical trial supply companies that need visibility into pharmaceutical markets across multiple
countries.

Where does PharmaFootpath source its data?

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
agencies, and verified public sources to ensure reliable information.

How often is the data updated?

Medicine shortage data is updated daily, while most other datasets, such as product registrations
and pricing, are updated weekly depending on the source schedule.

What markets does PharmaFootpath cover?

PharmaFootpath focuses on European pharmaceutical markets with additional coverage for Switzerland,
UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Brazil, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

We are continually expanding our market offerings. If you’re interested in a market not listed,
please contact us to check when it will be added!

How does PharmaFootpath help pharmaceutical procurement teams?

We identify where products are registered and commercialised, price information, who the
distributors are for the products, and various other details that accelerate sourcing products.

How does PharmaFootpath support parallel trade?

PharmaFootpath monitors and publishes both centrally authorised and national level parallel trade
licenses in Europe. We identify the origins of national parallel trade licenses, as well as review
and publish trends in the parallel trade markets.

How is PharmaFootpath different from traditional pharma data providers?

We're focussed on providing data to support international pharmaceutical businesses. Particularly
those looking to source internationally, export to new markets, identify unlicensed medicines, or
considering launching portfolio products internationally.

How can I access PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a cloud based application, so is accessible from any laptop or PC with internet
access.

### **О журнале**

«Фарматека» – рецензируемый научно-практический медицинский журнал, адресованный терапевтам,
педиатрам, кардиологам, эндокринологам, гастроэнтерологам, пульмонологам, дерматологам,
акушерам-гинекологам, урологам, онкологам, неврологам, ревматологам и врачам других специальностей.

Журнал «Фарматека» издается с 1994 года Начиная с первых номеров журнала на его страницах
публикуется информация о современных лекарственных средствах, их терапевтическом действии,
фармакокинетике и фармакодинамике, побочных эффектах, предназначенная для практикующих врачей;
освещаются последние достижения медицинской науки и техники, значимые клинические исследования
лекарственных средств, итоги международных и российских конгрессов и конференций.

С 2002 по 2017 год редакционный совет возглавлял член-корр. РАМН Юрий Борисович Белоусов, в совет
вошел ряд ведущих российских специалистов. Читательский круг журнала расширяется – издание читают
практикующие врачи, руководители медицинских учреждений и ВУЗов, НИИ, заведующие кафедрами, студенты
и соискатели.

В состав Редакционной коллегии журнала «Фарматека» входят ведущие российские специалисты основных
областей клинической медицины – 64 докторов медицинских наук. Все они принимают активное участие в
создании журнала и подтвердили согласие на вхождение в Редакционный совет.

Все номера журнала тематические и посвящены отдельным областям клинической медицины. Журнал выходит
с периодичностью 10 номеров в год. Объем полноцветного номера в среднем составляет 160–280 полос.
Тираж журнала превышает 25 тыс. экземпляров. Тираж сертифицирован Национальной тиражной службой.
Журнал «Фарматека» рассылается по подписке, распространяется на всех медицинских конгрессах, съездах
и конференциях на территории РФ, а также на обучающих циклах для врачей и студентов.

Журнал выпускается по следующим основным тематикам: Оториноларингология, Акушерство и гинекология,
Онкология, лучевая терапия, Урология и андрология, Внутренние болезни, Эндокринология, Кардиология,
Педиатрия, Инфекционные болезни, Дерматовенерология, Неврология, Ревматология, Пульмонология,
Восстановительная медицина, спортивная медицина, лечебная физкультура, курортология и физиотерапия,
Фармакология, клиническая фармакология. В журнале «Фарматека» публикуются оригинальные статьи,
клинические разборы, обзоры и лекции, посвященные наиболее актуальным проблемам фармакотерапии,
подготовленные ведущими специалистами соответствующих областей медицины.

Журнал «Фарматека» призван предоставлять читателям – широкому кругу врачей и научных медицинских
работников – наиболее актуальную информацию о результатах клинических исследований и новых, в т.ч.
инновационных, методах диагностики и лечения.

Журнал входит в перечень изданий, рекомендованных Высшей аттестационной комиссией (ВАК).

Ежегодно в рамках журнала «Фарматека» под редакцией М.Б. Анциферова - Главный внештатный специалист
эндокринолог Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы, главный врач ГБУЗ «Эндокринологический
диспансер Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы», доктор медицинских наук, профессор,
выпускается сборник избранных научных статей по эндокринологии «Современные аспекты фармакотерапии
эндокринных заболеваний». Сборник приурочен к Московскому городскому съезду эндокринологов.

# Shape the Future of Rare Disease at NORD's Breakthrough Summit®

**Washington, D.C. | October 25-27, 2026**

Register now for the NORD® Rare Diseases & Orphan Products Breakthrough Summit® — the leading event
for rare disease advocates, industry leaders, researchers, and policymakers.

[Register Today][246]
[NORD Summit Hero Image]

#### [Understanding New Medicaid Requirements][247]

Starting in 2027, community engagement or work requirements will apply to some Medicaid enrollees.
NORD has explainers for patients and caregivers, plus recommendations for state and federal
policymakers.

[LEARN MORE][248]

#### [Your Experience Can Shape the Future][249]

The Living Rare Study® is the first large-scale, long-term U.S. study tracking the evolving
experiences of individuals and caregivers impacted by rare diseases. Sharing your story can help
shape NORD programming, inform policy decisions, and improve access to resources that enhance
quality of life.

[JOIN THE STUDY][250]

#### [Rare Science on Demand][251]

Missed NORD's Rare Disease Scientific Symposium? Explore expert presentations, breakthrough
insights, and key research and regulatory discussions shaping the future of rare disease.

[ACCESS NOW][252]
[

### Patient Assistance Programs

][253]

Get help with access to medication, diagnostics, caregivers support, and other needs through NORD's
RareCare® programs.

[Get support][254]
[

### Rare Disease Database

][255]

Access our comprehensive database to view reports on more than 1,400 rare diseases.

[Search now][256]
[

### Rare Disease Centers of Excellence

][257]

NORD® Rare Disease Centers of Excellence are diagnosing and treating thousands of rare disease
patients.

[Learn More][258]
[

### IAMRARE^{®} Program

][259]

Assist researchers throughout the world better understand and treat rare diseases by enrolling in
our registry and sharing your experiences.

[Get involved][260]
[

### Living Rare Study®

][261]

Adults living with rare disease and caregivers can share their lived experiences to help drive
positive change.

[Participate Today][262]
[

### Help Advance Research

][263]

Discover how your rare experiences can help researchers and lead to a brighter future.

[Learn More][264]

**Washington, D.C. | October 25-27, 2026**

for rare disease advocates, industry leaders, researchers, and policymakers.

[Register Today][246]
[NORD Summit Hero Image]

#### [Understanding New Medicaid Requirements][247]

Starting in 2027, community engagement or work requirements will apply to some Medicaid enrollees.
NORD has explainers for patients and caregivers, plus recommendations for state and federal
policymakers.

[LEARN MORE][248]

#### [Your Experience Can Shape the Future][249]

The Living Rare Study® is the first large-scale, long-term U.S. study tracking the evolving
experiences of individuals and caregivers impacted by rare diseases. Sharing your story can help
shape NORD programming, inform policy decisions, and improve access to resources that enhance
quality of life.

## About us

### The Scottish Dental Clinical Effectiveness Programme (SDCEP)
* provides user-friendly, evidence-based guidance with recommendations and advice presented in a
  form that can be interpreted easily and implemented
* provides practical implementation advice to clarify changes in legislation, professional
  regulations or other developments
* supports dental teams to provide high quality healthcare that is safe, effective and
  person-centred

### SDCEP works in partnership

with the other three Clinical Effectiveness Workstream programmes:
* [Translation Research in a Dental Setting (TRIADS)][26] collaboration
* [Scottish Dental Practice Based Research Network (SDPBRN)][27]
* [Quality Improvement in Practice Training (QIiPT)][28] team

These comprise the [Clinical Effectiveness ][29]workstream of NHS Education for Scotland’s Dental
Directorate. SDCEP also collaborates with [Cochra][30][ne][31][ Oral][32][ Health.][33]

OUR SCIENCE | R&D

### Innovative medicines in the pipeline

Only 5% of rare diseases have approved medicines. The need for innovative treatments is, therefore,
high. A strong pipeline and expanded access are key elements of our commitment to patients.

[View pipeline][14]

### Focus on sustainability

Sobi celebrates meaningful progress on its climate journey – from validated science-based targets to
rising use of renewable electricity and fossil-free car fleets across several countries.

[Our climate progress][24]
RARE DISEASES

### Focus on Rare diseases

More than 10,000 rare diseases have been identified, with more being discovered every day. While
many rare diseases are very uncommon, together they affect 400 million people worldwide.

[Rare diseases][25]
INNOVATIVE TREATMENTS

### A new therapy’s path to the patient

Bringing new therapies to patients involves navigating long timelines and inherent risks, making it
a complex and costly endeavor. Discover how we prioritise patient access to treatment while
addressing these development challenges.

[From lab to patient][26]

### Our stories

At Sobi, we are dedicated to transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases.
Meet some of the people who inspire us.
Their real-life experiences and stories reinforce our commitment to patients.

## Discover More

Our Relentless Pursuit of Healing

[A black woman, smiling at a desk that has flowers and a pride flag displayed on it.]
Awards and Recognitions

### [ Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][154]

UMass Memorial earns recognition as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader, demonstrating its
commitment to inclusive, high-quality care for all.

[ Learn More about Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][155]
[A little girl high-fives the doctor in Urgent Care having had her ankle bandaged and a bad scrape
treated.]
Services-Treatments

### [ Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][156]

Summer happens — bites, burns, scrapes and all. Get expert care fast at a convenient UMass Memorial
Health urgent care location. On-site X-ray and labs are available.

 

[ Learn More about Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][157]
[A woman waves hello to a group of people in an online meeting.]
7.20.26 | Support Groups

### [ Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][158]

Join us on Monday, July 20, with special guest Carisa Lozoraitis, Cancer Quality Program Manager at
the Medical Center. We will have an open discussion, share information, and exchange experiences.

[ Learn More about Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][159]
[A CRNA in an operating room, smiling and looking at the camera.]
Careers

### [ We’re Hiring CRNAs ][160]

Join our team of outstanding CRNAs. We’ll offer you a strong and supportive culture, flexible
schedules, career growth opportunities and great benefits.

[ Learn More about We’re Hiring CRNAs ][161]

## Our System of Care

UMass Memorial Health is the health and wellness partner of the people of Central Massachusetts and
beyond. Our health system is made up of five hospitals, including a children’s medical center,
behavioral health services and a dedicated provider group.

From the last three decades, Yashoda Group of Hospitals has been providing quality healthcare for
the people in their diverse medical needs. People trust us because of the strong relationships we’ve
built with them over the years.

Under astute leadership and strong management, Yashoda Group of Hospitals has evolved as a centre of
excellence in medicine providing the highest quality standards of medical treatment to all sections
of the society. Our work has always been guided by the needs of patients and delivered by our
perfectly combined revolutionary technology, best medical expertise and advanced procedures.

# Best Multi-Speciality Hospital in Hyderabad

From the last three decades, Yashoda Group of Hospitals has been providing quality healthcare for
the people in their diverse medical needs. People trust us because of the strong relationships we’ve
built with them over the years.

Under astute leadership and strong management, Yashoda Group of Hospitals has evolved as a centre of
excellence in medicine providing the highest quality standards of medical treatment to all sections
of the society. Our work has always been guided by the needs of patients and delivered by our
perfectly combined revolutionary technology, best medical expertise and advanced procedures.
